guard: a provider-induced Harness API close during a delivered mesh turn leaves the seat alive, reconnects one private client to the exact existing session, and resumes mesh work; failure to replace that client is terminal rather than a loop
_note: The first failure is deliberately after a real mesh delivery and real Unix-socket close. It passes only after the host replaces and reattaches the private Harness client.

mutations.name: M1 restore the shipped defect: close exits the seat without recovery
mutations.expectRed: provider disconnect does not exit the mesh seat (#781)

mutations.name: M2 replace a disconnected client but forget the owned session
mutations.replace: /* mutant: replacement never attaches the owned session */
mutations.expectRed: recovered Harness client reattaches the existing private session (#781)

mutations.name: M3 make reconnect success terminal instead of resuming inbox delivery
mutations.replace: /* mutant: leave pending mesh work stranded after recovery */
mutations.expectRed: recovered seat redrives the unacknowledged stalled turn (#781)
